name: holobid
description: A live auction platform for collectible Pokemon cards.

scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test:web && npm run test:api && npm run test:db && npm run test:http && npm run test:auth
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=@holobid/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.build:api: npm run build --workspace=@holobid/contracts && npm run build --workspace=@holobid/api
scripts.build:web: npm run build --workspace=@holobid/contracts && npm run build --workspace=@holobid/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build --workspace=@holobid/contracts && npm run dev --workspace=@holobid/api
scripts.test:api: npm run build --workspace=@holobid/contracts && npm run test --workspace=@holobid/api
scripts.test:db: npm run build:api && npm run test:db --workspace=@holobid/api
scripts.db:seed: npm run build:api && npm run db:seed --workspace=@holobid/api
scripts.test:http: npm run build:api && npm run test:http --workspace=@holobid/api
scripts.db:release: npm run db:audit:migrate && npm run db:migrate
scripts.test:auth: npm run build:api && npm run test:auth --workspace=@holobid/api
